title: festuca pallens subsp. scabrifolia
intro: Festuca pallens subsp. scabrifolia, commonly known as a type of grass, is a plant species belonging to the family Poaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may aid in reducing stress and improving overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Festuca pallens subsp. scabrifolia include its ability to act as an antispasmodic, soothing muscle cramps and spasms, and its antimicrobial properties, which help to combat infections. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and alkaloids, although further research is needed to fully understand the plant's properties and potential applications.
